nodes.description: Owner address of BotProtected/Kattana; set to msg.sender in the Kattana constructor and used as the sole authorization gate for delegate() and list().
External contract address used by the checkBots modifier as the target of a low-level .call(); storing it in state makes the call target replaceable/attacker-relevant.
Uniswap pair address computed via pairFor() and passed into the bot-protection calldata; written in the Kattana constructor.
Public mapping of token balances in Kattana; mutated with unchecked -= and += in transferFrom() and overwritten wholesale in list().
Public nested mapping of allowances in Kattana; decremented unchecked in transferFrom() and set to uint(-1) in the constructor.
Total token supply fixed at 10000000000000000000000000; used in list() to compute the owner allocation.
IUniswapV2Router02 instance (0x7a25...) used for the external addLiquidityETH call in list().
Wrapped ETH address used together with address(this) to derive uniPair in the constructor.
checkBots(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) modifier of BotProtected: performs an external low-level call into botProtection BEFORE the modified function body executes.
Kattana.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Kattana.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic with no SafeMath.
Kattana.approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no checks.
Kattana.delegate(address a, bytes memory b) owner-only wrapper around a.delegatecall(b) with an unchecked success value.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap V2 pair address from a CREATE2-style hash.
Kattana.list(uint _numList, address[] _tos, uint[] _amounts) owner-only payable function that overwrites balances, calls addLiquidityETH and loops distributing tokens.
Kattana constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, computes uniPair, and grants infinite allowances to the router and the pair.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks (delegate/list), allowance spending (transferFrom/approve) and owner assignment.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list().
botProtection.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141, _from, _to, uniPair, _value)) low-level call executed before state updates in the checkBots modifier.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary attacker-supplied code in the context of this contract; the boolean result is ignored.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (Solidity ^0.7.0), relying only on a preceding >= require.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing silent wrap-around.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 arithmetic in list() executed without SafeMath.
uniRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) external call in list(), made before the token distribution loop completes.
Parameter _from of Kattana.transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _to of Kattana.transferFrom, the credited recipient.
Parameter _value of Kattana.transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter _spender of Kattana.approve, the address granted the allowance.
Parameter _value of Kattana.approve, the allowance amount set.
Parameter a of Kattana.delegate, the delegatecall target contract.
Parameter b of Kattana.delegate, the raw calldata forwarded to the target.
Parameter _numList of Kattana.list, the liquidity amount assigned to the contract balance.
Parameter _tos of Kattana.list, the array of recipients whose balances are overwritten.
Parameter _amounts of Kattana.list, the array of amounts written into balanceOf.
Parameter tokenA of pairFor.
Parameter tokenB of pairFor.
Local bytes isNotBot holding the unused returndata of the botProtection low-level call in the checkBots modifier.
Local address pair computed and returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller whose allowance is checked and decremented inside transferFrom, so caller identity drives the authorization branch.
msg.sender must equal owner for delegate() to proceed, a single-address privilege check.
msg.sender must equal owner for list() and is also used as the liquidity recipient, so the caller controls an owner-only state mutation.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve().
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, seeding the privileged identity that later guards delegate() and list().
transferFrom is decorated with the checkBots modifier, so the external interaction is triggered on entry before any balance or allowance state change.
The checkBots modifier executes the low-level call into botProtection as its first statement, creating an external entry point before the guarded body runs.
The call target is the mutable state variable botProtection, so whoever controls that address controls the pre-body callback.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender] to enforce and consume the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf for both _from and _to using unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom drives the unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
The unchecked subtraction writes back into the allowance mapping, allowing wrap-around if the >= require is bypassed or misused.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value mutations.
The unchecked balance arithmetic writes directly into the balanceOf mapping without SafeMath protection.
delegate() forwards into the a.delegatecall(b) unsafe operation whenever the owner check passes.
The delegatecall target a is fully caller-supplied and flows straight into delegate().
The raw calldata b is attacker-supplied and is executed verbatim in this contract's storage context.
list() computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 without SafeMath to fund balanceOf[msg.sender].
totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked multiplication in list().
The unchecked multiplication result is stored into balanceOf[msg.sender].
list() performs the addLiquidityETH external call before completing its balance-distribution loop.
The external addLiquidityETH call target is the uniRouter state variable, so the interaction is with an external contract.
block.timestamp is read inside list() to construct the transaction deadline, making execution time miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the router deadline argument, creating a timestamp dependency on the external swap call.
list() overwrites balanceOf[address(this)] and every balanceOf[_tos[i]] entry in its distribution loop.
transfer() unconditionally forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no bounds or checks.
pairFor() supplies the computed pair address stored in uniPair.
The Kattana constructor writes the pairFor result into uniPair.
The constructor pre-approves the router and the pair with uint(-1) allowances in the allowance mapping.
The BotProtected constructor parameter is stored into the botProtection state variable, fixing the callback target.
Parameter _value flows into the transfer and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
Parameter _from flows into transferFrom and is also forwarded to the bot-protection external call.
Parameter _to flows into transferFrom and receives the credited balance.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve().
Parameter _value is the allowance amount stored by approve().
Parameter _numList flows into the liquidity amount and balanceOf[address(this)] assignment in list().
Parameter _tos drives the distribution loop and the Transfer events in list().
Parameter _amounts supplies the balance values written in the list() loop.
Parameter tokenA is hashed into the pair address computation.
Parameter tokenB is hashed into the pair address computation.
The isNotBot local receives the low-level call return data inside the checkBots modifier, though only the boolean success flag is checked.
The pair local is assembled and returned by pairFor.
The external botProtection call can re-enter transferFrom (or any public payable function) before allowance and balance state is updated, since the modifier runs first.
